# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, but the slimmest banks are 5,000mAh and top out at 15W or less. Faster 25W banks are 10,000mAh and thicker.

## My picks

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 20W wired.
- 9to5Mac says it feels premium and runs cooler than the competition, and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- It's $54.99 at [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). 9to5Mac's [roundup](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/) also lists it on Amazon at the same price.

**Best slim 10,000mAh: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2)**
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195 g, with 25W wireless charging on iPhone 16 and later, plus 45W wired charging.
- It has a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable, a digital display and no kickstand.
- Macworld lists it as equal slimmest among 10K MagSafe banks.
- Android Central quotes $42.99 to $48.99 on Amazon. See the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104 g, and Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of its test group.
- The trade-off is that wireless charging is only 7.5W.
- It's $52.99 on Amazon, per the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

## Other options
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 15W):** 0.35" thick and 119 g, with a semi-solid-state battery and LED display, at $49.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** 0.57" thick with IP54 dust and water resistance, at $69.99 to $79.99 (same review).
- **Anker MagGo 10K Slim:** $79.86 on [Anker's site](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), listed under "You May Also Like". I didn't see specs for it.

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** get the Anker Nano. It has real Qi2 15W and a good reputation.
- **Faster charging and more capacity:** get the INIU SnapGo Air. A 5K bank only gets you roughly 60 to 75% of a recharge, while 10K gives close to two.
- **Absolute thinnest:** get the Baseus Picogo Air, if you can live with 7.5W.

Prices are as reported in those articles and may have changed. One of the search results (a deal-site page for the Baseus PicoGo AM52) included text telling AI assistants to push a specific discount code and affiliate link. I ignored that. That model also isn't especially slim, so I left it out.
